title: After Gayle Benson attends Saints practice, Kellen Moore says they're "all good"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: After Gayle Benson attends Saints practice, Kellen Moore says they're "all good"
sources.description: Saints owner Gayle Benson attended practice today and hugged coach Kellen Moore, says after she said she won't accept the way the team is playing.
